verdict.rationale: Carta has no native automation feature in the evidence. It does offer a client-credentials OAuth flow that needs no user approval, plus service accounts, so you can build your own headless integrations that run in the background against its API. The MCP plugins are interactive, natural-language query tools, not autonomous background jobs. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automations, webhooks or event triggers, documented background-agent workflows, independent corroboration.
